rationale: The sense 1 heading and definition scope its that-clause frame to suspicion of crime, wrongdoing, or dishonesty, and its example reinforces that reading. Sense 3 separately covers neutral or positive inferences and gives its own that-clause frames. The finding’s proposed complement limit is therefore already conveyed by the sense placement and surrounding text.
applicable_scope: Sense 1 heading, definition, frame, and example; sense 3’s separate frames and usage note.
